summary: Core University Living Real Estate Income Trust filed a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) on October 16, 2026, setting the November 1, 2026 transaction price equal to each share class's September 30, 2026 NAV per share. Aggregate NAV was $134.3 million across 13.2 million shares; Class A NAV was $10.1654 and Class E $10.1779. The student-housing portfolio was valued at $308.4 million against $180.4 million of mortgage debt, using a 5.87% exit cap rate and 7.62% discount rate. No special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine NAV update with no deal terms to arbitrage.
